provenance.model: Newton monopoles plus total-degree-two M-Q per figure; no Q-Q/tides/EIH/contacts
provenance.units: SI; inertial positions/velocities/S, body-to-inertial unit quaternion

contrast.A: Unchanged production cold packet from exact saved checkpoint; endpoint must reproduce archived row.
contrast.B: Clone same function; replace center with center_initial+drift_initial*t0 and drift with drift_initial. Sameaxes/Galilean fixedCOM frame. Same rawAPI inputs/settings/time, bothcold.
contrast.C: Only encode/decode, before/after exactbinary64 vs Fraction arithmetic. No integration. Inverse roundtrip coefficients recorded.
contrast.additional: Disabled clone control at main standard and fixed-center-equals-A control. No warm-continuation surrogate.

provenance.baseline_rule: Any A != frozen historical endpoint: STOP new science, investigate without changing SHA.
provenance.controls_rule: Run fixed predeclared controls only if main passes equivalence/noninterference and some A/B q/S/relative phase-space or adaptive-step path differs beyond only absolute output representation. Otherwise STOP controls as not causally discriminating.
provenance.stopping_rule: Invalid contrast/equivalence => STOP. No further experiments if changes only confounded coordinate/control/roundoff. No fullruns/parametersearch.
provenance.physical_scope: Observed differences of saved inputs/solutions, not globalerror truth; commoncoordinate encoding rounding quantified separately, local contrasts not fullFAIL attribution.
